## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Pokémon-inspired card pack simulator with collection, progression, unlocks, rebirth, and duplicate handling.

## Requirements
- Buy and open card packs; collect cards.
- Unlock the collection journal at level 2, pack storage at level 5, multiple-pack purchases at level 9, and card hunting at level 12.
- Improve card odds with rebirth.
- Include the requested card tiers: “normal,gold,normal,diamond,godlike,special,secret.”
- Let players sell or trash duplicate cards.

## Decisions
- Implemented a standalone responsive browser game with localStorage saves and three original themed packs.
- Interpreted the repeated “normal” tier as an additional Rare tier.
- Packs contain three cards; rebirth unlocks at level 15, preserves the collection, and resets level, coins, and stored packs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game UI and mechanics for pack purchases/opening, collection, progression, unlocks, storage, journal, hunting, rebirth, and duplicate handling.
- Added a favicon and fixed the malformed title tag.
- Verified `node --check game.js`, opened the game in browser, checked the home screenshot, opened a pack and confirmed three results, and rechecked the console with zero errors.
